versions.content: The Ethernet Interface shall encapsulate Virtual Local Area Net- works (VLAN) into virtual controllers (Ethernet Interface controller) representing a ded- icated VLAN. All BSW modules above the Ethernet Interface shall interact based on those virtual controllers. The Ethernet Driver and Transceiver deal only with real controllers and are not aware of the existence of virtual controllers. Caveat: the virtual controller represents the untagged VLAN if no VLAN ID is set.
